{{Quote|I already have one of our best starships waiting for you at the spaceport. Your astromech droid is prepping it for takeoff.|General Suthra|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
'''Docking Bay 74''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking area]] in the [[Coruscant Spaceport]], located on the edge of the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="New Intelligence" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] arranged for a [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] to be delivered to the docking bay for a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] to use to travel to the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], as part of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] mission to stop the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] from utilizing stolen [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] against the Republic. The [[Coruscant Spaceport Authority]] also authorized the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] to continue to use the docking bay for the [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|ship]] whenever the Jedi's crew returned to Coruscant over the next few [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Behind the scenes==
Docking Bay 74 first appeared in the Jedi Knight mission "New Intelligence" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. Throughout the rest of the game, it serves as the default hangar for Jedi Knight players when they return to Coruscant.<ref name="New Intelligence" />
